prompts.mangrove: Use case: stylized-concept. Project game asset, ONE isolated tree on genuinely transparent RGBA background, no ground patch, no text, no grid, no shadows outside roots. Full tree including crown and root base with generous transparent margin. Three-quarter front elevated viewpoint for a 2D top-down indie horde action game. Style: readable cartoon PIXEL ART, simple exaggerated silhouette, about 5-7 distinct canopy clusters, rich internally stepped material shading and subtle ordered pixel dithering, colored restrained outline, light from upper left. Fine native pixels, NOT enlarged 8-bit blocks; not photorealistic, not 3D render, not smooth vector, not ornate fantasy. Dark muted shadows and warm highlight ramps. Whole tree resembles a polished small indie sprite with clear crown/trunk/base hierarchy. Subject: a squat MANGROVE tree with a broad dark emerald and moss green clustered crown, multiple reddish brown branching trunks, and five prominently exposed arching stilt roots forming open spaces under the trunk. Roots reach widely sideways and touch the same ground plane. Strong silhouette of roots is essential. No water or terrain included.
